notes.title: STACK STONES - Full Release - Play Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155964/82d79b842fe5706f635a065828a5ea3261cf9587.gif[/img]

Finally I've reached the point to be able to release [b]STACK STONES[/b]!
This is my first commercial release as an Indie Game Developer and I'm super excited to share the game with everyone.

[i]STACK STONES, a physics based multiplayer stacking and party game with multiple game modes. Enjoy playing alone to beat your former best mark or compete against others in funny multiplayer matches ... but watch out for your opponents, they want to smash your stack![/i]

I deeply hope you enjoy playing it and also have lots of fun in the multiplayer sessions. If you encounter any issues or have improvement ideas for the gaming experience please contact me via my [url=https://discord.gg/k36etWAcRa]DISCORD[/url] or leave a message in the Steam Discussion area (Community Hub).

I will definetly check all your feedback and improve the game where ever possible. 

Thank you to all who have joined my journey and for sure to all of the new players!


Regards
Thomas

notes.title: STACK STONES - Live Stream @ Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155964/20c8416ccee69027c0e2a75e45d2ad915b52535a.gif[/img]

I'm proud to be part of the Steam Next Fest in June and hope you will have a chance and enjoy STACK STONES together with me (the dev)!


[b]STACK STONES[/b], a physics based multiplayer stacking game with multiple game modes. Enjoy playing alone to beat your former best mark or compete against others in funny multiplayer matches ... but watch out for your opponents, they want to smash your stack!


I deeply hope you enjoy playing it and also have lots of fun in the multiplayer sessions. As STACK STONES will be my first commercial game, I really would like to get feedback from every player. So I will be able to improve the gaming experience via your support and input.

To make this game great, I need your help to play and let me know your experiences, both good and bad, on my DISCORD.

I will definetly check all your feedback and improve the game where ever possible. Thank you in advance for your help!


Regards
Thomas
